applicant.name: Dr. Gernot Pfeiffer
applicant.organisation: Tyrolia Health Insurance, actuarial research unit

purpose: Actuarial risk research: we want to quantify how chronic conditions drive long-term care costs, so that our product team can refine the risk classes and tariffs of our new supplementary health cover.
question: How many adults have heart failure, type 2 diabetes or COPD, by age band?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = ICD-10 starting with I50; type 2 diabetes = E11; COPD = J44.
Report per band: adults with heart failure, adults with type 2 diabetes and adults with COPD.
